ProfessionalListController

class ProfessionalListController(view, factory)[source]

Bases: QObject

Controller of the professional list window (MVCS).

Mediates between ProfessionalListView and ProfessionalService: loads and filters the table, shows the details of the selected professional and opens the edit dialog to create or update professionals.

Parameters:
viewProfessionalListView

The list view.

factoryCallable

Creates the edit dialog: factory(parent, professional=None) returns ProfessionalEditView.

Attributes:
viewProfessionalListView

The list view.

factoryCallable

Factory of the edit dialog.

serviceProfessionalService

Shared service of professionals.

msgMessageService

Service used to show messages.

Notes

The table is reloaded automatically when the service emits professional_change (observer pattern), keeping the current search text. The buttons, search field and table selection are connected when the controller is created, and the table is loaded right away. Messages are translated with self.tr().

Methods
